text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world, but it also brings serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias. If the data used to train AI systems contains unfair patterns, the AI can make biased decisions, for example in hiring or lending. Fairness means we must carefully check these systems to reduce such errors. Another issue is privacy. AI often needs large amounts of personal data, so we must protect that information and use it only with permission. Transparency is also essential: people should understand why an AI made a certain choice, not just receive a mysterious result. Finally, responsible AI development means that creators, companies, and governments work together to set clear rules. This ensures that technology helps everyone safely and honestly.
